hint.rinse: Rinse the burette with a little NaOH so water does not dilute it.
hint.removeFunnel: Take the funnel off the burette.
hint.indicator: Add a suitable indicator to the flask.
hint.swirl: Swirl the flask to mix before adding more.

mistake.no_goggles.name: No safety goggles
mistake.no_goggles.why: Acids and alkalis can splash into your eyes and cause serious injury.
mistake.no_goggles.fix: Put on goggles before handling any chemical.
mistake.funnel_left.name: Funnel left on the burette
mistake.funnel_left.why: A funnel left in the burette can drip extra titrant into the flask that you did not measure, and it can tip over.
mistake.funnel_left.fix: Remove the funnel after filling and before you start titrating.
mistake.unrinsed_burette.name: Burette not rinsed with NaOH
mistake.unrinsed_burette.why: Water left in the burette dilutes the NaOH, so its real concentration is lower and your result is wrong.
mistake.unrinsed_burette.fix: Rinse the burette with a little NaOH, drain it, then fill it.
mistake.no_indicator.name: No indicator added
mistake.no_indicator.why: Without an indicator you cannot see when the solution is neutralised.
mistake.no_indicator.fix: Add a few drops of a suitable indicator before you titrate.
mistake.wrong_indicator.name: Unsuitable indicator
mistake.wrong_indicator.why: This indicator changes colour far from the equivalence point, so you would stop at the wrong volume.
mistake.wrong_indicator.fix: Pick an indicator whose colour-change range sits inside the steep part of the pH curve. Phenolphthalein suits both of these acids with NaOH.
mistake.too_fast_near_endpoint.name: Added too much too quickly near the endpoint
mistake.too_fast_near_endpoint.why: Near the endpoint one drop changes the pH sharply, so a large addition can jump straight past it.
mistake.too_fast_near_endpoint.fix: Slow down to single drops once you are within about 2 mL of the endpoint.
mistake.overshoot.name: Overshot the endpoint
mistake.overshoot.why: Too much NaOH makes the solution strongly basic and your volume reading too high, so the calculated concentration comes out too high.
mistake.overshoot.fix: Add drops slowly and stop at the first lasting colour change.
mistake.no_swirl.name: Did not swirl the flask
mistake.no_swirl.why: Without mixing, the NaOH is not spread through the flask, so the colour change appears late or in patches.
mistake.no_swirl.fix: Swirl the flask after every addition.
mistake.empty_burette.name: Burette was empty
mistake.empty_burette.why: There was no NaOH in the burette to add.
